title: Kofi (auditor)
description: Persona: an auditor who checks that every access under a data sharing agreement was allowed and its duties were done. Fictional.

persona.name: Kofi
persona.goal: Show, for any access, which consent and which agreement allowed it.
needs: Provenance that cites the consent and its version
Duty checks he can run himself
frustrations: Logs that say who, but not why
